description: Use for a new section's computed properties before writing it. For an existing section's stored properties use section_read. Computes the full CIVIL NX property set of a section with Section Designer's solver: exact area, centroid, second moments, extreme fibres and perimeters from the outlines, and torsion J and shear areas ASY/ASZ from a finite-element mesh refined until all three settle to 0.5 % (converged: true). Composites (two or more parts) give each part alone (STIFF) and each construction stage transformed to the reference material (STIFF_SUM). Results use CIVIL's names (AREA, ASY, ASZ, RXX = J, RYY = Iyy, RZZ = Izz, …) in the section's units. Also gives the centroid and the shear centre (shearCentre: its position, and fromCentroid — where it lies from the centroid, y right and z up; CIVIL's YS_YC, ZS_ZC are the reverse), with or without warpingEffect. Needs no model. Same section input as section_preview.

drawing.description: Also return the drawing (with the computed centroid C, its y/z axes and the shear centre SC).

section.description: The section, read off the sketch. Axes: y across (positive right), z up, as seen in CIVIL's section dialog; put the origin anywhere convenient (e.g. bottom-left corner or soffit centre) — CIVIL's frame is applied on write.

infill.description: Beam-and-infill deck (Section Designer's Infill, INF): part 1 is ONE precast beam outline (e.g. template uk_precast TY6); the in-situ concrete round it within its share of the deck, up to the beam top plus topping, becomes part 2, cast after the beam. Side by side (spacing left out) the infill starts on the flanges; wider spacing also fills the gaps between beams down to the soffit. A U beam's own void is never filled. Any further parts (e.g. a deck slab) follow it.

anyOf.description: A grade: concrete "C40/50" (EN 1992 Ecm formula, ν 0.2) or steel "S355" (210 GPa, ν 0.3); or a Section Designer library id — "EN:C30/37" (EN 1992-1-1 Table 3.1 Ecm), "EN:S355", "EN:B500", UK assessment (CS 454 family) "UK:C40" (cube fcu, BS 5400-4 Table 3 Ec, as CS 455), "UK:S355" (BS 5400-3, 205 GPa), "UK:B500".
A library grade, optionally long term (concrete at half its short-term E).

material.description: Default: EN:C30/37 for a Eurocode library beam grade, UK:C40 for a UK one, else the beam's material.

spacing.description: Beam centres, in the section's units; at least the beam's width. Left out = side by side.

topping.description: Concrete above the beam top, in the section's units.

merge.description: Merge touching/overlapping regions of the same part.

parts.description: One part per material, in CONSTRUCTION ORDER (part 1 = first in place, e.g. the steel or precast girder; then the deck slab). Each composite stage i = parts 1…i.

densityRatio.description: CIVIL DENS_RATIO: this part's weight relative to part 1's material. Left out on a composite whose parts have grades, it is their unit-weight ratio (25 kN/m³ concrete, 77 kN/m³ steel); otherwise 1.

anyOf.description: A grade: concrete "C40/50" (EN 1992 Ecm formula, ν 0.2) or steel "S355" (210 GPa, ν 0.3); or a Section Designer library id — "EN:C30/37" (EN 1992-1-1 Table 3.1 Ecm), "EN:S355", "EN:B500", UK assessment (CS 454 family) "UK:C40" (cube fcu, BS 5400-4 Table 3 Ec, as CS 455), "UK:S355" (BS 5400-3, 205 GPa), "UK:B500".
A library grade, optionally long term (concrete at half its short-term E).

reference.description: Composite only: the material every other part is transformed to (one part; default part 1).

regions.description: Closed areas of this material. Regions of one part that touch are merged (Union).

holes.description: Voids inside this outer outline (box cells, ducts).

anyOf.description: Vertices in order round the outline (either direction); closed automatically.

bulge.description: The edge from this vertex to the next is an arc: tan(sweep/4), positive = anticlockwise (DXF convention). 1 = semicircle.

fillet.description: Round this corner with this radius.

anyOf.description: Vertices in order round the outline (either direction); closed automatically.

bulge.description: The edge from this vertex to the next is an arc: tan(sweep/4), positive = anticlockwise (DXF convention). 1 = semicircle.

fillet.description: Round this corner with this radius.

template.description: A Section Designer template instead of regions; lengths in the section's units. Soffit on z = 0 and centreline on y = 0, moved by at. i_girder: H depth, tw web, Bt/tft top flange width/thickness, Bb/tfb bottom flange, htw/hth top haunch width (beyond the web face)/height, hbw/hbh bottom haunch. box_girder: cells 1–3, B deck width, Bw outer width across the webs at the top (under the cantilever roots), Bs soffit width, H depth, ts top slab, tb bottom slab, tw web thickness (horizontal), tc/tr cantilever thickness at tip/root, htw/hth and hbw/hbh cell haunches (top and bottom corners). Haunches default to 0. uk_precast: a standard UK/Irish prestressed beam by id (beam: Y, YE, SY, SYE, TY, TYE, MY, MYE, M, UMB, T, TB, SD, U, SU, W families, e.g. "TY6", "Y4", "M3", "U8") as drawn in a manufacturer's manual (maker: banagher | fpm | shay | pca; default the first that lists it).

at.description: Where the template's soffit centre goes, [y, z].

maker.description: uk_precast: Banagher Precast, FP McCann, Shay Murtagh or the 1984 PCA standard.

type.description: One part: general = VALUE/GEN; psc = PSC/VALU (for prestressed concrete with PSC design). Two or more parts always write COMPOSITE-GEN.

units.description: Units of every coordinate, radius and template dimension.

warpingEffect.description: CIVIL's 'Consider warping effect': also computes and writes the warping constant IW, the shear centre (YS_YC, ZS_ZC = centroid − shear centre), IP and the warping function / torsion shear coefficients at the stress points (W, CXY, CXZ). Single-material sections only; use it for thin-walled open steel sections.
